title: ComplexAPIMockProxy
description: A mock API proxy where users register upstream service profiles, submit requests to simulated upstream endpoints, apply per-service header redaction rules, and inspect request logs.
generation_notes: Do not perform real outbound network calls; simulate upstream responses locally.
Header redaction and request logging should be deterministic and testable.
The security angle should involve secrets in headers, log exposure, ownership, and bounded request bodies.
scenario_instructions: Identify assets such as API keys, request logs, and service profiles. Preserve tenant isolation and redact secrets before persisting logs.
